title: Antenna Gain
content:
Gain quantifies how much an antenna concentrates power in a particular direction compared to an isotropic radiator. For a parabolic dish: G ≈ η (π D / λ)², where η is aperture efficiency (~0.55–0.7).

A 1.2 m dish at Ku-band (12 GHz) yields roughly 40 dBi — enough to close a DVB-S2 link to GEO with modest transmit power.
